name: Query blocks
description: Shows the notes a base code block's query finds, below its code in a note.
author: Nether contributors

codeBlocks.name: Query
codeBlocks.text:
views:
  - type: table
    order: [file.name, file.folder, file.mtime]
    sort:
      - property: file.mtime
        direction: DESC
    limit: 10
